name: P06 door leaf stays shut until Confirm

steps.msg: standing near doors keeps leaves shut

steps.note: Confirm opens the inn leaf then enters

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const Field=(await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field;const w=Field.world();const door=(w.map.props||[]).find(p=>p.doorId==='puddlewick_inn'||(p.type==='door'&&/inn/i.test(p.name||'')));if(!door)return 'no-door';door.talk({field:Field});await sleep(200);const kit=w.view&&w.view.kit;const amt=kit&&kit.doorAt&&kit.doorAt('puddlewick_inn')&&kit.doorAt('puddlewick_inn').amount;window.__DOORAMT=amt;for(let i=0;i<30&&__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick';i++)await sleep(100);return JSON.stringify({amt:window.__DOORAMT,map:__DQ.state().map.id});})()
